items.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023
items.q: I participated in a rehearsal band with — I think it was Adolph Sandole or Dennis Sandole, one of the guys.

ctx.x: Well going back to those clarinet etudes you were playing on guitar, your reading must have gotten pretty strong. I’m wondering if you ever found yourself in a situation with a piece of guitar music in front of you going oh my, this is like, I need to woodshed this before I can play it?

Yeah, well yeah absolutely. I participated in a rehearsal band with — I think it was Adolph Sandole or Dennis Sandole, one of the guys. And they had — the music was just so difficult, I’m telling you now, in my lifetime I might not be able to play it at the speed it was to be played at. It just was physically not in my capabilities. Maybe someone else could have done it but it would have taken years for me to have that under my fingers and maybe never ever get it. But there was a trumpet player on this — when you…
You currently have opportunities to get out and perform?
